label: Simplified substitute payment: ceiling for a former employee
appliesTo: Former employees whose arrears the state pays under the Wage Claim Guarantee Act, foreign nationals included
why: The state does not underwrite the whole debt. Wage-type arrears and retirement benefits each have their own ceiling, and the combined payment is capped below their sum — so the two component limits cannot be added together. Set by Enforcement Decree, which means it moves without the Act changing.

history.source: Ministry of Employment and Labour — Labour Portal, unpaid wage resolution routes
history.note: Combined ceiling. The component limits are ₩7 million for covered wage-type arrears and ₩7 million for covered retirement benefits; a claimant cannot add them to reach ₩14 million. Still-employed claimants are capped separately.
